name: Agroforestry integration (trees/shrubs within cropland)
description: Introduce trees or woody perennials into or alongside cropland to add structural and vegetational complexity to the farming system.
prerequisites: Land tenure/permission to plant perennial woody species
Baseline habitat_diversity or species_richness measurement recommended before planting

name: Crop diversification / intercropping
description: Grow two or more crop species together in the same field (spatially or in rotation) instead of a single monoculture crop.
prerequisites: Compatible companion crop identified for the region and target crop
Assessment of market/logistics for a second crop

name: Cover cropping / soil organic matter management
description: Plant non-cash cover crops between main crop cycles to protect and potentially build soil organic matter.
prerequisites: Suitable cover crop species for climate and rotation window

name: Native hedgerow / field-margin habitat strips
description: Establish strips of native shrubs and perennial vegetation along field margins to add semi-natural habitat elements to the landscape.

name: Water harvesting & soil moisture conservation (contour bunds, mulching, micro-catchments)
description: Use low-cost earthworks (contour bunds, micro-catchments) and mulching to capture and retain rainfall on-site, improving soil moisture available to plants.
prerequisites: Suitable slope and soil type for chosen structure

name: Integrated pest management (reduced/targeted pesticide use)
description: Replace routine broad-spectrum pesticide applications with monitoring-based, targeted interventions combining biological, cultural, and chemical controls.
